content:
已替換為 [https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/cobblemon-visual-tweaks](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/cobblemon-visual-tweaks) (1.7+)
- 傑尼龜軍團

- 取代原始模型

- 適用於傑尼龜的寶可夢資源包

- 將圓框眼鏡作為默認外觀，尖框眼鏡作為閃光外觀

- 使用來自 [RedRibbonz](https://modrinth.com/user/RedRibbonz) [Poke_Costume](https://modrinth.com/datapack/poke-costume/gallery) 的尖框眼鏡

- 以 cobblemon 傑尼龜模型為基礎 [https://gitlab.com/cable-mc/cobblemon-assets/-/tree/master/blockbench/pokemon/gen1/0007_squirtle](https://gitlab.com/cable-mc/cobblemon-assets/-/tree/master/blockbench/pokemon/gen1/0007_squirtle)
